def logrot(R):
    # world axis-angle log
    v=np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])*.5
    sn=np.linalg.norm(v); c=(np.trace(R)-1)*.5
    th=np.arctan2(sn,c)
    if sn<1e-8:
        if c>0:return v
        # rare pi
        w, V=np.linalg.eigh((R+np.eye(3))/2); return V[:,-1]*np.pi
    return v*(th/sn)

def ik(pos,Rtar,q0=None,maxiter=300):
 q = (d.qpos[jq].copy() if q0 is None else q0.copy())
 for it in range(maxiter):

  p=d.xpos[bi].copy(); R=d.xmat[bi].reshape(3,3).copy()
